title: Capability Preservation Metrics During Unlearning: A Standardized Evaluation Protocol

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: A standardized evaluation protocol is useful infrastructure but does not itself produce a safety finding. Impact is indirect through enabling better comparison of unlearning methods.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Running five different unlearning methods and evaluating each on a battery of capability benchmarks requires extensive implementation and compute. Each unlearning method has its own codebase and setup.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Five unlearning methods times multiple capability benchmarks is a large evaluation matrix. Even scoped to 2 methods and 3 benchmarks, the setup overhead is substantial for 30 hours.
